title: Colors of Christmas. Large Set.
author: Art Garden
description:
Let’s add a new twist to the Christmas color scheme.
A modern look at tradition will bring unexpected emotions and a touch of mischief into your projects.
It is iperfect for Christmas cards and gifts wrapping decoration. Enjoy!
Collection of hand drawn PNG objects by colored pencils.
Large collections of objects, arrangements, spots, frames, wreaths and patterns.
Red and pink poinsettia flowers, pomegranate, snow globe
For christmas card, wrapping, menu card, restaurant decor, packaging, price tags, banner, invitation, label, gift wrapping, restaurant wall art, food poster. christmas party decor, Xmas wedding invitation
Also you can match to create your own design from graphic objects.
You can add decorative or colorful backdrops as you like.
Merry Christmas PNG. Christmas PNG bundle. Christmas wreath. Christmas vacation PNG. Floral digital paper.
THIS KIT INCLUDES:
41 PNG separate files with objects (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
16 PNG separate files with Xmas arrangements (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
4 frames with spots (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
5 stains by colored pencils (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
12 PNG separate files 12″*12″ with Xmas seamless patterns and digital paper (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
5 PNG separate files with Xmas geometric wreaths (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
You can use them in Illustrator, Photoshop, Canva.
